title: Splitting strategies for the fully-coupled nonlinear thermo-hydro-mechanical problem
summary: We propose novel semi-decoupled and fully-decoupled iterative algorithms for efficiently solving the fully-coupled nonlinear four-field thermo-poroelastic model discretized in space by discontinuous Galerkin method on polytopal grids. We present the model problem, its four-field formulation, and the arbitrary-order weighted symmetric interior penalty scheme exploited for its spatial discretization.
